notes: Dockerfile.final compiled from structured environment artifacts. Base image is continuumio/anaconda3:latest (Debian Bullseye). System packages installed via apt-get. Conda environment 'benchmark' created with Python 3.11 and Pillow 10.3.0 (security fix). eval.sh and tests/ are runtime-mounted verifier assets, not baked into the image. Image uses repo_setup.sh for repository materialization into /workspace.
